description: Denmark Annual Accounts - CVR Financial Statements (Årsrapport). Get the filed annual reports (årsrapport) of Danish companies by CVR number (8 digits): revenue, gross profit, net profit, total assets, equity, liabilities and employees, with the prior year included, balance-checked. One row per company, fiscal year and statement type (up to 5 years; group accounts optional - companies that file group accounts only, such as listed IFRS groups, return those). Use it after a free CVR identity lookup when you need the financials. If the run is not finished in time, the tool returns {status, runId, note} - call regdata_run_result with that runId instead of re-running (re-running bills twice). No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyIds.description: Danish CVR numbers, 8 digits, up to 1,000 per run. Example: 21766909.
companyIds.title: CVR numbers

includeConsolidated.description: Also return the consolidated group accounts next to the company's own accounts. Each group statement is an extra row and an extra charge. Companies that file group accounts only (for example listed IFRS companies) get them either way. Off by default.
includeConsolidated.title: Include group (consolidated) accounts

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

years.description: How many of the most recent fiscal years to return for each company (1 to 5). Each year is one row and one charge.
years.title: Fiscal years per company

name: regdata_denmark_annual_accounts
